breadWalletDescription: Bread Wallet is a simple and secure way to manage your digital money privately.
chooseHowToProtect: Choose how you want to protect your wallet
biometricSetupReason: Set up biometric unlock for your wallet
biometricUnavailable: Biometric unlock isn't available on this device.
guardianInfoDescription: A Guardian is an independent service that cosigns every transaction from your wallet, adding a safety net without giving up self-custody.
guardianInfoWhatItDoesDescription: Approves or rejects transactions based on your security policy. Helps you recover if you lose your device.
guardianInfoWhatItCannotDoDescription: Move your funds on its own. Access your private state. See your balances unless you share them.
guardianInfoSwitchingIsEasyDescription: You can rotate to a different Guardian — or remove one entirely — at any time using your recovery phrase.

forgotPasswordDescription: If you've forgotten your password, you need to sign out and re-import your account. After that, you can create a new password.
forgotPasswordSecondDescription: Do not sign out unless you know your 12-word Seed phrase or have an encrypted backup file.
biometricUnlockRequiredDescription: This wallet uses biometric authentication only. Use Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode to unlock. To access your wallet on another device, use your 12-word Seed phrase.
chooseImportTypeDescription: Restore public balance with your 12-word phrase. To restore private balance, upload an encrypted backup file.
importWithSeedPhraseDescription: Use an existing 12 word recovery phrase. You can also import wallets from other wallet providers.

switchGuardianConfirmation: This is signed with your recovery (cold) key and co-signed by your current guardian. Your funds and account stay the same. Continue?
guardianAboutDescription: Guardian cosigns every transaction from this wallet, giving you a second-factor safety net without taking custody of your funds. You can rotate or remove your Guardian anytime with your recovery phrase.
customEndpointDescription: Paste a Guardian URL if you're running your own.
oldGuardianCantBlockTitle: Your old Guardian can't block this
oldGuardianCantBlockBody: Rotation is approved by your two on-device keys. The old Guardian is only notified.
replaceHotKeyDescription: Generate a new device (hot) key and replace the current one on-chain. Useful if you suspect your device is compromised.
replaceHotKeyConfirmation: This is signed with your recovery (cold) key. Your seed phrase is not required, and your funds and account stay the same. Continue?
hotKeyRotationOverlayBody: Your device (hot) key is being rotated. This is required when setting up a recovered account so it can sync and make transactions.
hotKeyRotationFailedGeneric: Something went wrong while rotating your device key.

guardianUrlMismatch: That operator doesn't match your account's on-chain guardian.

guardianKeysRevealDescription: Your Guardian account is protected by three keys: a device (hot) key for routine signing, a recovery (cold) key derived from your seed phrase for account-management operations, and an external guardian co-signer. Below are your cold private key plus both public keys. To reveal the device private key, use Settings → Reveal Device Key.

hotKeyRevealWarningBody: Anyone with this key can sign transactions until you rotate it. If the key is leaked, rotate it via Settings → Rotate Device Key.
